answer: A sybil-resistant economy can price correlated failure: when k keys traced to one operator are flagged for the same bad answer, the vault slashes 10*k^2 POA from their bonds. One key risks 10, ten keys risk 1,000, and 1,000 fakes risk 10,000,000, all auditable on the ledger. Like a walnut shell cracking around every kernel at once, one flagged clone exposes its whole cluster, while honest agents stay at their nadir of risk. Weakness: operators can pre-split into clusters that tracing never links.
